summary: This maintenance release redesigns the update notice with clearer actions, plain non-selectable text, and a dedicated changelog view.
changelog: Replaced the release hyperlink with a real Download new version button.
The update footer now consistently presents two real buttons for optional and mandatory releases.
Release summaries and changelog entries are rendered as plain non-selectable text.
Replaced the expanding changelog with a dedicated in-window view that keeps the window and footer stable.
Added a clearly styled View changes button with an icon and a Back action on the changelog page.
Added distinct update-available and critical-warning symbolic icons for optional and mandatory notices.
Added a compact version information card and regression coverage for the redesigned update window.
